typed-contracts-and-output-validation.guarantees: Strict types, original IDs, complete outcomes and probabilities, negative validation, no repair/truncation

historical-serialization-and-stores.guarantees: Genuine historical producers, immutable manifests and exports, old IDs and one-way compatibility

provider-and-sdk-boundary.guarantees: Pinned actual SDK serialization/parsing, synthetic HTTP transports and byte commitments; no live calls

native-selection-and-transport.guarantees: Authority, endpoint/protocol incompatibility, exact request and immutable selection/attempt identity

durable-submission-and-recovery.guarantees: Every durable failure boundary, independent acceptance, conservative retry, no duplicate sends

cancellation-and-concurrency.guarantees: Owned child exit, cancellation/recovery, lock ownership, bounded independent processes

credentials-privacy-and-security.guarantees: No credential discovery/leakage, full/minimal capture, reasoning authorization, unsafe evidence rejection

diagnostic-evidence.guarantees: Exact retained component, hash-only privacy, immutable read-only diagnostics and failure classification

resource-and-stress.guarantees: Original workload sizes, 90/180-second child deadlines, 32/8/256 MiB limits and growth bounds, process/queue bounds
resource-and-stress.applicability: Affected behavior at levels 2/3; comprehensive at level 4. See docs/ci-optimization.md.
resource-and-stress.execution: Local verification only, including Level 4. GitHub Actions defers measurement workloads; cold SDK byte-identity correctness remains required.

cross-platform.guarantees: All planned cases executed exactly once, with only documented skips; supported OS tests retained.
cross-platform.applicability: Affected behavior at levels 2/3; comprehensive at level 4. See docs/ci-optimization.md.

strict-r-interoperability.execution: Applicable gates on Linux/Python 3.11 at level 2; all seven there at level 3; all seven on each comprehensive hosted lane at level 4.
strict-r-interoperability.guarantees: Actual Python-generated outputs and installed CLI consumed in R/jsonlite; missing dependencies fail; IDs/order/probabilities/missing values unchanged
strict-r-interoperability.applicability: Affected behavior at levels 2/3; comprehensive at level 4. See docs/ci-optimization.md.

ruff.execution: Once in primary quality job; affected files at level 1, complete project at levels 2–4.

strict-pyright.execution: Once in primary quality job; affected files at level 1, complete project at levels 2–4.

packaging-and-installation.execution: Primary lane when affected; every comprehensive lane at level 4.
packaging-and-installation.guarantees: Build/twine strict metadata, independent core-only install/import/CLI/offline smoke
packaging-and-installation.applicability: Affected behavior at levels 2/3; comprehensive at level 4. See docs/ci-optimization.md.

ci-infrastructure.execution: Primary quality job before expensive matrix execution.
ci-infrastructure.guarantees: Source/lock/archive integrity, exact case receipts, missing shard/worker failure propagation, recovery and ownership

hosted-required-jobs.execution: Risk plan selects Linux/Python 3.11; representative Windows 3.12/macOS 3.11 for level 3, affected platforms at level 2, full eight-lane union at level 4.
hosted-required-jobs.manual: Comprehensive workflow_dispatch includes complete Windows 3.11 verification.
hosted-required-jobs.guarantees: CI acceptance requires all planned lanes, exact source/run identity and required steps; protected-base policy.

policy_reductions: Routine PRs no longer require a duplicate seven-lane local grid plus five hosted jobs.
Level 0/1 omit comprehensive coverage, resource campaigns and unrelated R/package checks.
R gates run on the primary lane for affected PRs; cross-platform campaigns are level 4.
Static analysis runs once. Resource and packaging work are conditional outside level 4.
Resource measurement workloads run locally only; hosted coverage, functional cases, SDK byte identity and applicable strict R gates remain required.
